# arifOS /world — State of the World (SOT) Atlas

> Live situational atlas · Δ geopolitics · Ω economics · Ψ social
> DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — Forged, not given.

## What this is

A dark-mode, browser-served atlas of the world built on three civilization axes:

- **Δ GEOPOLITICS** — conflict, war, sanctions, diplomacy
- **Ω ECONOMICS** — economy, oil, markets, trade
- **Ψ SOCIAL** — humanitarian, refugees, health, protests

The composite **SOT** index is the mean of the three axes' tension values (0–100).
Tiers map to: 0–40 STABLE, 40–70 TENSE, 70–100 CRITICAL.

## Data sources (all free, no API keys)

- **GDELT DOC 2 API** — `https://api.gdeltproject.org/api/v2/doc/doc` — live news, geo-tagged
- **World Bank API** — `https://api.worldbank.org/v2` — country indicators + income tier
- **topojson world-atlas** — npm package, 110m resolution

CORS-enabled. Throttled to 1 GDELT request per 5 seconds (fair-use).

## Routes

- `/` — Atlas (map + news rail + gauges)
- `/about` — Methodology (this document)
- WB tier map: toggle **TIER** in the map header to color countries by income classification
  (HIC high, UMC upper middle, LMC lower middle, LIC low)

## Agent-readable surfaces

- `/llms.txt` — this file
- `/world/` — full atlas (this SPA)
- `mcp.arif-fazil.com/mcp` — arifOS constitutional kernel (organ MCP)

## Framed under the agentic web world model

This page is a narrative surface under one human domain (arif-fazil.com).
Organ subdomains (geox · wealth · well · mcp) are agent doors, not rival brands.
Doctrine: https://arif-fazil.com/docs/AGENTIC_WEB_WORLD_MODEL.md

## Build

React 19 + Vite 7 + TypeScript 5 + Tailwind 3 + shadcn/ui.
No backend. No tracking. No auth. Pure static SPA.

4 tiers, 4 lending types) bundled in `src/data/wb_countries.json`.
